channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Jensen Beach Park restrooms and cafe rebuild expected by late 2027
item.description: Beachgoers at Jensen Beach Park are waiting for the rebuild of the park's restrooms and concession building destroyed in a fire on New Year's Eve in December 2024. The county says the new Sea Turtle Beach Cafe will seat 100 people with 33 bar seats.

item.title: Jensen Beach Park restrooms and Sea Turtle Beach Cafe rebuild delayed until late 2027
item.description: Beachgoers at Jensen Beach Park are waiting for the rebuild of the park's restrooms and concession building, which was destroyed in a fire on New Year's Eve in December 2024. The county says final funding is expected to be approved in September.

item.title: 28-year-old man dies after weekend double shooting on South 14th Street in Fort Pierce
item.description: A 28-year-old man died Tuesday after he was shot multiple times in Fort Pierce over the weekend. The shooting happened early Sunday morning at about 3:43 a.m. in the 300 block of South 14th Street.

item.title: St. Lucie County Clerk's website goes down for hours after redirection issue
item.description: The St. Lucie County Clerk and Comptroller's website was down for hours Tuesday morning before coming back online around 1:30 p.m.

item.title: Trump called FIFA president to get Balogun red card suspension lifted before U.S. World Cup match
item.description: President Donald Trump intervened on behalf of American forward Folarin Balogun, calling FIFA president Gianni Infantino to request a review of the red card that would have suspended him from the Belgium match.

item.title: Messi leads Argentina to stunning 3-2 comeback over Egypt to reach World Cup quarterfinals
item.description: Lionel Messi scored his eighth goal of the tournament and led Argentina to an improbable 3-2 victory over Egypt on Tuesday after trailing by two goals with only 11 minutes left in regulation time.

item.title: International Olympic Committee ends neutral status vetting for Russian athletes ahead of 2028 LA Olympics
item.description: The IOC advised Olympic sports bodies on Tuesday to end a three-year program vetting Russians for neutral status ahead of qualifying events for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

item.description: A Leon County judge set aside two days later this month to decide whether Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback meets Florida's seven-year residency requirement to run for governor. item.title: FDA recalls frozen Publix GreenWise organic blueberries sold in Florida and seven other states over E. coli contamination
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration issued a recall for frozen Publix GreenWise Organic Blueberries due to possible E. coli contamination. The product was shipped to Publix retail stores throughout Florida, Alabama, Georgia, Kentucky, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee and Virginia.

item.title: Median-income Florida households need 17 months longer to save for home down payment than a decade ago
item.description: A new study by Smart Asset found that it now takes the median-income household earner in Florida 17 months longer to save up for a down payment in 2026 than in 2016. For Floridians earning minimum wage, the burden is far greater.

item.title: Marion County alligator attack forces amputation of 11-year-old Pennsylvania boy's right hand
item.description: An 11-year-old boy is recovering at home in Pennsylvania after an alligator attack in Marion County resulted in the amputation of his right hand. The boy and his father were fishing at Nelson's Fish Camp near Umatilla when the incident happened two weekends ago.
